summary: Documentation updated to reflect the config-ownership migration: added migration-only export endpoint (GET /services/{name}/config/export), deprecated config-write endpoints (410 Gone with Deprecation/Sunset headers), and described the boundary split between Docker-boundary settings (retained) and runtime config (component-owned). Updated docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (public API surface list + config-ownership note), README.md (new 'Config-ownership migration' subsection), and AGENT.md (API endpoint table + deprecation callout). No changes needed to docs/lifecycle/api.md — the existing mkdocstrings directive auto-generates from the source docstrings.
